records.subject: All modeled preferred-orientation Cu3Sn/Cu interfaces
records.quote: First-principles calculations based on Density-Functional theory and Semi-classical Boltzmann thermal transport theory have been applied to research the interfacial stability, electronic structures, bonding properties, and thermoelectric transport properties of different preferred crystallographic orientation interface of Cu3Sn/Cu.
context_quotes: All interface models proved to have stable structures, the interfacial ideal adhesion of works of Cu3Sn (025)/Cu (042) interface, Cu3Sn (100)/Cu (100) interface, and Cu3Sn <010>perpendicular to Cu (100) interface are 1.956 J/m(2), 1.182 J/m(2), and 2.126 J/m(2), respectively.

records.subject: Cu3Sn <010> perpendicular to Cu(100) interface
records.conditions: 300 K; first-principles and semiclassical Boltzmann transport framework
records.quote: First-principles calculations based on Density-Functional theory and Semi-classical Boltzmann thermal transport theory have been applied to research the interfacial stability, electronic structures, bonding properties, and thermoelectric transport properties of different preferred crystallographic orientation interface of Cu3Sn/Cu.
context_quotes: All interface models proved to have stable structures, the interfacial ideal adhesion of works of Cu3Sn (025)/Cu (042) interface, Cu3Sn (100)/Cu (100) interface, and Cu3Sn <010>perpendicular to Cu (100) interface are 1.956 J/m(2), 1.182 J/m(2), and 2.126 J/m(2), respectively.

Moreover, the electrical conductivity and thermal conductivity of 16.787 x 10(8) S m(-1) and 1.136 x 10(4) W m(-1) K-1 at 300 K for the Cu3Sn <010>perpendicular to Cu (100) interface are superior than the other two Cu3Sn/Cu interfaces.
modality_evidence: First-principles calculations based on Density-Functional theory and Semi-classical Boltzmann thermal transport theory have been applied to research the interfacial stability, electronic structures, bonding properties, and thermoelectric transport properties of different preferred crystallographic orientation interface of Cu3Sn/Cu.
